scripts.format: prettier --write package.json .prettierrc.json openapi-ts.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json packages src/web scripts && uv run ruff format packages/contracts/python src/api
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json .prettierrc.json openapi-ts.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json packages src/web scripts && uv run ruff format --check packages/contracts/python src/api
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check packages/contracts/python src/api
scripts.build: pnpm contracts:generate && tsc --outDir dist --noEmit false && pnpm --filter @featherlane/web build
